### Lessons from Leprosy - Truth For Life - September 29
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-29-2019.html
Passage: Leviticus 13:13
Points:
- The ancient regulation declaring a person covered in disease clean illustrates a vital spiritual truth.
- True spiritual leprosy consists of concealed, unconfessed sin, whereas recognizing one's total defilement is the path to mercy.
- Spiritual cleansing requires abandoning self-righteousness and honestly admitting complete brokenness before God.
- A deep awareness and sorrow over sin indicates that the Holy Spirit is actively working within the heart.
- Christ promises never to cast out anyone who comes to Him acknowledging their complete unworthiness.

### Bible Pathway - February 6
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-6-2013.html
Passage: Leviticus 13:44-46
Points:
- Being pronounced unclean brought deep sorrow and forced an individual into isolation outside the community.
- Just as leprosy often begins as an apparently harmless spot, sin initially seems small but grows destructive.
- Unchecked sin produces a state of spiritual death and separates individuals from fellowship with God.
- Confronting human affliction reminds believers of their duty to minister to those who are suffering.
- Complete cleansing from the defilement of sin comes only through confession and faith in Christ.
